llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及SLM工艺中的热传递模拟，未涉及生物医用植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is purely a thermal numerical study of powder bed heat transfer in SLM; it does not address porous implant design, stress shielding, mechanical testing, fatigue, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM中粉末床热传递机理
summary_zh.method: 建立颗粒介质热传递数值模型
summary_zh.result: 揭示了颗粒尺度的热传递行为

summary_en.motivation: To understand the heat transfer mechanism in powder bed during selective laser melting for process optimization.
summary_en.method: A numerical model of heat transfer in granular medium was developed to simulate the thermal behavior of powder particles.
summary_en.result: The study revealed the particle-scale temperature distribution and heat flux characteristics.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated by comparing with numerical benchmarks and thermal history data.

papers.title: Additive manufacturing of maraging steel on a copper substrate using selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究马氏体钢与铜的增材制造连接，与生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on dissimilar metal joining via SLM, with no biomedical context, no porous structures for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration consideration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化将马氏体钢直接沉积在铜基板上的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 使用SLM工艺参数优化，分析界面结合质量和微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 成功实现了钢铜界面的冶金结合，但存在热应力裂纹。
summary_zh.validation: 通过金相、SEM和EDX表征界面微观结构。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of directly depositing maraging steel onto a copper substrate using selective laser melting for dissimilar metal joining.
summary_en.method: Optimization of SLM process parameters and characterization of interfacial bonding quality and microstructure.
summary_en.result: Successful metallurgical bonding at the steel-copper interface was achieved, but thermal stress-induced cracks were observed.
summary_en.validation: Interfacial microstructure was validated through metallography, SEM, and EDX analysis.

papers.title: The Effect of UV Treatment on the Osteoconductive Capacity of Zirconia-Based Materials.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Improvements in the bioactivity of zirconia implants for accelerated healing and reduced morbidity have been of continuing interest in the fields of dentistry and orthopedic surgery. The aim of the present study was to examine whether UV treatment increases the osteoconductivity of zirconia-based materials. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Smooth and rough zirconia-based disks and cylindrical implants were treated with UV light for 15 min and subsequently placed in rat femurs. Surface characterization was performed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and contact angle measurements. RESULTS: In vivo histomorphometry revealed that the percentage of bone-implant contact and the amount of bone volume, formed around UV-treated implants, increased by 3-7-fold for smooth surfaces and by 1.4-1.7-fold for rough surfaces compared to non-treated specimens at Weeks 2 and 4 of healing, respectively. A biomechanical test showed that UV treatment accelerated the establishment of bone-zirconia integration and enhanced the strength of the bone-implant interface by two-fold. Additionally, surface characterization of the zirconia disks revealed that UV treatment decreased the amount of surface carbon and converted the hydrophilic status from hydrophobic to superhydrophilic. CONCLUSIONS: This study indicates that UV light pretreatment enhances the osteoconductive capacity of zirconia-based materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究UV处理对氧化锆植入物骨整合的影响，未涉及股骨近端应力分析或有限元建模。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain quantification, no micromotion analysis, no patient-specific or population-based FE simulation, and no comparison between intact and implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 增强氧化锆植入物的骨整合能力以加速愈合。
summary_zh.method: UV处理氧化锆圆盘和圆柱植入物，植入大鼠股骨进行体内实验。
summary_zh.result: UV处理使骨-植入物接触和骨体积增加3-7倍（光滑表面）和1.4-1.7倍（粗糙表面）。
summary_zh.validation: 通过组织形态计量学和生物力学测试验证骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether UV pretreatment enhances the osteoconductivity of zirconia-based dental and orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: UV-treated smooth and rough zirconia disks and cylindrical implants were placed in rat femurs, and surface characterization and in vivo histomorphometry were performed.
summary_en.result: UV treatment increased bone-implant contact and bone volume by up to 7-fold for smooth surfaces and 1.7-fold for rough surfaces at weeks 2 and 4, and doubled the strength of bone-implant integration.
summary_en.validation: Validation was done via in vivo histomorphometry and biomechanical push-out tests in a rat femur model.
